{{Quote|We have two new transponder signals. A kilometer out and closing. The craft themselves are not on the sensors. I think they’re at ground level. They're now sending standard starfighter transponder data. Their designations are Phanan One and Phanan Two.|Unidentified Pop-Dog|<ref name="MK" />}}
The [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] '''Phanan Two''' was used by [[Myri Antilles]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], during their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] to prove the corrupt activities of Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref>

Antilles, along with her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]], [[Voort saBinring]], who used the callsign [[Phanan One]], flew modified [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] and strafed the [[Chakham Army Base]], destroying six [[E-wing starfighter|E-wings]] and a [[Gidders's shuttle|shuttle]] belonging to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gidders]]. Afterwards, they engaged in a [[Starfighter combat|dogfight]] near [[Skifter Station]] and destroyed two E-wings piloted by [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite Galactic Alliance Army unit led by Thaal.<ref name="MK" />

The name was derived from [[Ton Phanan]], one of the original Wraiths who had since died.<ref name="MK" />
